line: Your n8n retry doesn't just try again. It can do the exact same thing twice.
n8n workflows default to trying at least once — a timeout retry replays the whole step, side effects and all.
One real case: a real API call finished — but the response never came back.
Without a check, the retry does it again. With one, it stops itself.
It hadn't worked — so it ran again.
Save a key first. Find it there, and stop.
One check. Any external call needs it.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
